Our Story
Land Rover Garage was founded with a straightforward belief: that a failed engine shouldn't mean the end of a vehicle you love — or a bill that writes it off.

After more than 15 years working hands-on with Land Rover powertrains, we saw the same pattern repeating. Owners were being quoted £8,000 to £15,000 by main dealers for engine replacements. Many were told it wasn't worth repairing. Others paid for short-term fixes that didn't address the root cause — and failed again months later.

We knew there was a better way. Our workshop in Billericay, Essex was set up to do one thing exceptionally well: rebuild engines to a standard that matches or exceeds factory specification — at a price that makes the repair a sensible decision, not a financial stretch.

Today, we've rebuilt hundreds of engines across the Ingenium, TDV6, TDV8 and other Land Rover platforms. We know these engines intimately. We know what fails, why it fails, and — most importantly — how to make sure it doesn't fail again.
**A Note on Our History**

Land Rover Garage was incorporated in 2024 (Company No: 16500838). Our founder has been working professionally on Land Rover diesel and petrol engines since 2010, gaining over 15 years of hands-on industry experience before establishing this independent specialist workshop. The expertise is longstanding; the business is new.
What We Do
We are an engine rebuilding specialist. This is not a sideline service. It is everything we do. Every job follows the same disciplined process.
**1. Full Diagnostic Assessment**
We don't guess. Every vehicle is assessed using professional diagnostic equipment before any work begins, so we identify the root cause, not just the symptom.
**2. Complete Strip-Down & Inspection**
The engine is disassembled and every component examined. We measure tolerances with digital micrometers. Anything outside specification is identified.
**3. Ultrasonic Cleaning**
All reusable components are ultrasonically cleaned to remove carbon deposits, sludge, and contaminants before reassembly.
**4. Precision Rebuild**
Replacement parts are OEM-specification or premium-grade only. No shortcuts on components. No reusing worn parts. Calibrated torque tools used throughout.
**5. Bench Testing & Compression Checks**
Before the engine goes back into your vehicle, it's tested. Oil circuit pressure checked, coolant system leak-tested, compression verified across all cylinders.
**6. ECU Reset, Coding & Road Validation**
After fitting, we reset and recalibrate the engine control unit and road-test the vehicle to confirm everything is performing as it should.

Our Workshop
We operate from a dedicated engine workshop at **Unit A5, Windsor Road, Commercial Estate, Ramsden Heath, Billericay, CM11 1QE**.

Unlike a general garage, our facility is set up specifically for engine work. That means the right lifting equipment, the right diagnostic tools, the right measuring instruments, and — most importantly — an environment where precision matters. Clean work areas. Organised components. Methodical processes.
We welcome customers to visit and see the workshop before committing to any work. Transparency builds trust, and we have nothing to hide.
**Nationwide collection and delivery available.** Enclosed transport for non-drivable vehicles. Contact us to arrange logistics.
Why Vehicle Owners Choose Us
**Specialist, Not Generalist**
Every technician in our workshop works on Land Rover engines every day. That depth of focused experience means faster diagnosis, fewer mistakes, and a better outcome.
**Honest Pricing**

A main dealer engine replacement typically costs £6,000 to £9,000. Our rebuilds range from approximately £2,100 to £5,800 — including labour, parts, fluids, and ECU coding. Detailed itemised quote before work begins. You pay only when the job is complete and you're satisfied.
**12-Month Unlimited Mileage Warranty**

Every engine we rebuild or fit is covered by a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty on parts we supply and labour we carry out. Terms are clearly set out — no hidden surprises. [Read full warranty terms →](/warranty)
**Nationwide Service, Local Care**
We collect and deliver vehicles anywhere in the UK. Your car is transported by trusted courier partners, and we keep you informed at every stage — from initial assessment to final road test.
**Real Reviews, Earned Not Bought**
With a 4.7/5 rating across 78 verified reviews, our reputation is built on results. We don't pay for reviews. We earn them by doing the job properly and standing behind our work.
**Who We Work With**

Private vehicle owners, independent garages, and specialist motor traders across the UK. Whether you need your daily driver back on the road or a trade engine solution, same standard of work and transparent pricing.

Frequently Asked Questions
**How long does an engine rebuild take?**

Typically 2 to 4 weeks, depending on the extent of work required and parts availability. We'll give you a realistic timeframe when we provide your quote and update you proactively if anything changes.
**Do I need to pay upfront?**

No. We don't take deposits. You pay when the work is complete and you're satisfied. For large builds, staged payments aligned to milestones may be requested but are always agreed in writing beforehand.
**What about my warranty if I sell the car?**
Our warranty is personal to the original customer and is not transferable. If the vehicle is sold, the warranty ends. This allows us to keep our pricing fair for everyone. Full terms at `/warranty`.
**Can you work with my local garage?**

Yes. We regularly supply reconditioned engines to independent garages across the UK for them to fit. We also offer a full supply-and-fit service at our Billericay workshop. Trade pricing and technical support available.
**What happens if something goes wrong after the rebuild?**

Contact us within 14 days of noticing any issue. We'll inspect the vehicle at our workshop and, if the issue falls within our warranty cover, we'll put it right at our cost. We stand behind every engine that leaves our workshop.
**Do you service vehicles or do MOTs?**

We offer routine servicing and mechanical repairs. MOT testing is not carried out in-house — we refer to trusted local MOT partners where required. All emission system repairs maintain UK MOT compliance.
Our Commitment

We set out to extend the life of premium Land Rover vehicles — with expertly rebuilt engines, honest pricing, and service you can trust. That's not marketing language. It's how we've operated from day one.
If your Land Rover needs engine work, we're here to help. Call us, email us, or fill out our online form — and we'll give you an honest assessment and a fair price.
